messages:
marta: Morning — noticed acme-prod hitting intermittent 429s on Dedicated around 03:10 UTC. They have 1k reserved RPS but logs show "quota_exceeded: burst_window". Any quick thoughts? :thinking:

jia: I saw a spike like that for beta yesterday. Looks like burst accounting is local to nodes; if requests cluster on one shard you can get throttled even if tenant-wide reserve exists. pinging infra-bot for logs. :eyes:

infra-bot: deploy/alerts: 1923456890 - quota-throttle spike on dedicated-pool-7; affected tenants: acme-prod,beta. Logs: https://ops.internal/logs/1923456890 (redacted)

leo: hypothesis: reserved throughput is per-tenant but enforcement is shard-local to avoid noisy neighbors. That means the console number (1k) is misleading unless you show per-node effective ceilings.

samir: UX problem — customers see "reserved = absolute". We should expose both tenant-level reservation and per-node soft-cap. Also need telemetry for per-node credit balance + refill rate.

emily: Could we implement cross-node borrowing of burst credits? If node A runs out it could ask node B for credits before returning 429. Might add a hop though.

jia: cross-node borrow requires atomic-ish bookkeeping or a fast eventual-consistent counter. Both are doable but not trivial; risk extra latency and complexity. Maybe better to start with visibility + soft-queue.

leo: console idea: show: 
- Reserved throughput: 1000 RPS
- Per-node soft cap: 125 RPS (8 nodes)
- Burst window: 60s
- Current effective credits: 800 (aggregated)
This makes it clear why a single hotspot sees 429s.

marta: Yes. Also add alert when tenant-level reservations vs allocated across nodes diverge >20% so we catch imbalance early. :+1:

samir: I'll draft a small RFC. Two immediate proposals: 1) Add per-node cap & heatmap to console; 2) Emit metric dedicated.tenant.<id>.burst_imbalance_ratio and alert on >0.2.

infra-bot: ticket created: PLT-4821 - "Dedicated: expose burst accounting per-node + console visibility". Assigned samir.

jia: Short-term mitigation idea: instead of immediate 429 on local credit exhaustion, queue for 50ms and retry locally; if still no credit return 429. That reduces client errors for flappy bursts.

leo: Prefer controlled queueing to avoid head-of-line blocking. Suggest: max_queue_ms=50, max_queue_len=20 per-tenant-per-node. Need to test tail latency impact.

marta: Agree. Prioritize visibility + small soft-queue. Samir, can you include perf tests and integration plan in the RFC?

samir: Will do. I'll prototype metrics and a console mock by EOD Friday. Adding @ops-bot for runbook updates.

ops-bot: runbook updated: dedicated-throttle-handling v1.1. Notes: soft-queue=50ms; alert PLT-4821.

emily: Thanks all. Also add a one-line note for release notes: "Dedicated: clarified reserved throughput semantics; added telemetry for burst imbalance; soft-queue mitigation".

marta: Great. Follow-ups: samir to share RFC link, jia to coordinate perf tests, leo to sketch console mock. We'll reconvene after RFC review. :wave:
